# netbox_route_targets (Data Source)

Retrieves all route targets from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_route_targets" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "route_targets_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_route_targets.example.route_targets[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `route_targets` (Attributes List) The route targets found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_targets))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.

### Nested Schema for `route_targets`

- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the route targets.
- `name` (String) The name of the route targets.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the route targets.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the route targets.
